fixed_review_comparisons.comparison_basis: Secondary: SkillFlow repeat one versus the prespecified reviewed repeat one, and original repeat one versus its review. No reviewed substitute is selected after failure.
fixed_review_comparisons.cost_basis: Use original answer plus fixed review, as retained in cost-ledger.json.
fixed_review_comparisons.interpretation: Incomplete or unresolved pairs cannot establish a review benefit, equivalence, or survival of a main-arm advantage.

source_defined_strata.interpretation: Source-defined mandatory-check strata, averaged across repetitions within each eligible case and then across cases. An absent stratum is undefined, not a perfect score. Missing or disputed grading stays unknown. Unclassified source checks remain explicit; these checks are not independent samples or exposure-unit precision/recall.

semantic_metrics.interpretation: Descriptive secondary human measurements. Repetitions are averaged within cases; source cluster identities are retained. Recall uses source-positive cases and reduction coverage uses cases with reference-required reductions; these denominators are determined by the source reference. No inferential advantage or quality noninferiority is established by this table. Undefined precision and unresolved/missing assessments remain unknown; an empty unsupported-claim set is not proof of correctness.

interpretation: No method advantage is inferred while results or human checks remain incomplete. Indeterminate results remain visible; failures do not disappear from the denominator.
human_identity_limit: Human scores are explicit self-attested submissions. The software does not independently establish personhood.
